Use an Astro project. Save examples at the shown src paths. Astro files are built into HTML and need the Astro tool; they do not run as plain HTML in this playground.

blocks.title: Build known dynamic routes

blocks.text: Read the code step by step

items: `Astro.props` holds values supplied to an Astro component or generated route at render time.
`getStaticPaths` lists the parameter values and props for dynamic pages in a static Astro build.

blocks.text: The build creates two book pages with their own titles.

blocks.title: A mistake to avoid
blocks.text: Every parameter value must match the bracketed route name. Unknown slugs are not generated automatically.
